# Gulf Coast Palms

> Tree trimming and removal for oaks and pines, storm cleanup, and established palm expertise — from palm trimming and diamond cutting to installations and removals.

Gulf Coast Palms LLC provides tree services and palm care across Northwest Florida. Experienced tree crews include an experienced climber. Over a thousand properties served. Owner-confirmed 5.0 rating and 168 five-star Google reviews as of 2026-10-15; existing review excerpts checked September 18, 2026.

## Contact

- Phone / text: (850) 910-1290
- Email: info@gulfcoastpalmservices.com
- Website: https://gulfcoastpalmservices.com

## Service area

Pensacola, Navarre, Gulf Breeze, Destin, Fort Walton Beach, Milton, Pace, 30A, Perdido Key, Niceville, Mary Esther, Santa Rosa Beach, Crestview, Perdido — Perdido Key to 30A.

- [Palm Tree Installation](/services/palm-tree-installation): Professional palm tree installation with 1-year warranty. We source, deliver, and hand-plant premium palms across the Florida Emerald Coast.
- [Palm Tree Removal](/services/palm-tree-removal): Safe, professional palm tree removal across the Emerald Coast. Licensed & insured crews with proper equipment for any size job.

## What makes us different

- Tree services and established palm care are equally important, with experienced crews and an experienced climber.
- Tree scope is based on species, condition, property goals and access; cleanup and haul-away scope is agreed in writing.
- Stump grinding is separately quoted when requested.
- Stay clear of unstable trees; contact emergency services or the utility for downed wires or immediate danger.
- Storm cleanup scheduling is subject to safe access and conditions; a quote request is not emergency dispatch.
